title: 第13章  狠狠的吻她第14章  肿了
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢淡淡的瞥他一眼，“你不知道为什么？”
裴西川拧眉。
“因为白雾眠？”
某个男人反应得很快，一下子就猜到了。
原来，她如此介意白雾眠，他的目光暗了一些。
知道她爱惨了永夜，所以介意他的女朋友，就连人家上他的飞行器，她都能生气的离开。
裴西川心头微微有点不爽。
季欢听到白雾眠就来气，她冷哼一声。
“是呀！”
裴西川的脸色更暗了，他不希望她跟自己在一起的时候还想着别的雄性。
永夜也不行。
他突然变得严肃起来。
“吃完了吗？吃完就跟我走。”
他伸过手握抓住她的手，要带她离开。
季欢突然笑了起来，“你要带我去哪里？开房，还是去你家？”
程永夜可是在这里的，他敢让程永夜知道吗？
就在这时，程永夜从厨房回来了，他身边跟着服务员。
服务员把两份牛排放到桌上，并跟季欢说。
“小姐，这位先生为你亲自煎的牛排，他对你可真好！”
程永夜额头上有着一层细细的汗珠，头发的造型也有点乱了，没有刚刚那么完美。

他摘了墨镜，看着裴西川，他一只手抓着季欢的手。
裴西川在看到他的时候，蓦地松了手。
两个男人四目相对。
“西川，你怎么在这里？”
季欢笑看着裴西川，她想看他的反应，他会怎么解释？
裴西川轻咳一声，掩饰着他此时的慌乱。
“我看到季欢就进来了，想尝尝她手里的酒是什么味道？”
程永夜却不太信，“是吗？她喝过的你也喝吗？我记得你有洁癖。”
裴西川在心底暗想，吻都吻过了，还介意她喝过的酒吗？
裴西川看了眼季欢，她那副看好戏的样子，实是在是欠造。
“我只是闻酒香！”
程永夜坐下，又把墨镜戴上了，因为旁边有几个雌性正往他这边看。
他怕被人认出来，那么就无法和季欢一起吃饭了。
程永夜没管裴西川，而是看向季欢。
content_en:
Ji Huan glanced at him lightly, "You don't know why?"
Pei Xichuan frowned.
"Because of Bai Wumian?"
A certain man reacted quickly and guessed it all at once.
It turned out that she cared so much about Bai Wumian, and his eyes darkened a little.
Knowing that she loved Yong Ye badly, so she didn't care about his girlfriend. Even if someone got on his aircraft, she would leave angrily.
Pei Xichuan felt slightly unhappy.
Ji Huan got angry when she heard Bai Wumian, and she snorted coldly.
"Yes!"
Pei Xichuan's face turned darker. He didn't want her to think about other males when she was with him.
Not even eternal night.
He suddenly became serious.
"Have you finished eating? Follow me after you finish."
He reached out and grabbed her hand to lead her away.
Ji Huan suddenly laughed, "Where do you want to take me? To a room, or to your home?"
Cheng Yongye is here. Does he dare to let Cheng Yongye know?
At this moment, Cheng Yongye came back from the kitchen, followed by the waiter.
The waiter put two steaks on the table and told Ji Huan.
"Miss, this gentleman cooked the steak for you himself. He is so kind to you!"
There was a thin layer of sweat on Cheng Yongye's forehead, and the style of his hair was a bit messy, not as perfect as before.
He took off his sunglasses and looked at Pei Xichuan, who was holding Ji Huan's hand with one hand.
When Pei Xichuan saw him, he suddenly let go.
The two men looked at each other.
"Xichuan, why are you here?"
Ji Huanxiao looked at Pei Xichuan. She wanted to see his reaction. How would he explain?
Pei Xichuan coughed lightly, hiding his panic at this time.
"I came in when I saw Ji Huan. Want to taste the taste of the wine in her hand?"
Cheng Yongye didn't believe it, "Really? Did you drink what she drank? I remember you have mysophobia."
Pei Xichuan thought in his heart, he had already kissed her, but did he still mind the wine she drank?
Pei Xichuan glanced at Ji Huan. She looked like she was watching a good show, which was really bad.
"I just smell the wine!"
Cheng Yongye sat down and put on his sunglasses again, because there were several females next to him looking at him.
He was afraid that if someone recognized him, he would not be able to eat with Ji Huan.
Cheng Yongye ignored Pei Xichuan and looked at Ji Huan.
